theme_strategy.reasoning: As an internal SaaS operations tool for tracking attendance and schedules, clarity, authority, and data density are paramount. The high-contrast Swiss archetype ensures legibility and immediate identification of anomalies (like scheduling clashes), while avoiding the 'clinical' feel via stark, structural aesthetics.

headings.usage: H1-H4, dashboard metric labels, module titles

data_and_code.usage: Project codes, statistics, numerical data in tables, Excel upload details

structure.sidebar: Fixed width 256px (w-64), h-screen, fixed positioning, flex col.
structure.footer: py-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-400 border-t border-slate-200 mt-12

specific_pages.dashboard: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 for metric cards. Use cardless sharp design (rounded-md max) with 1px border.
specific_pages.master_calendar: Strict 7-column grid (grid-cols-7). Dense border-collapse style. Gapless borders. Clashes indicated by 2px solid #DC2626 border and absolute positioned red tags.
specific_pages.programs: Bento grid mode. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3. gap-6. Heights must stretch identically.
specific_pages.mentor_sow: Dense tabular layout. Table spanning full width. Sticky headers.

buttons.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-400 focus:ring-offset-2
buttons.danger: bg-red-600 text-white hover:bg-red-700 rounded-md px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

cards.style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-md shadow-sm. No extreme box-shadows. Flat and crisp.
cards.clash_card: border-red-500 bg-red-50/50. Red text for metrics.

inputs.style: border border-slate-300 rounded-md bg-white focus:border-blue-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-blue-500 text-sm

sidebar_nav.style: flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-md text-sm font-medium transition-colors

toast_notifications.usage: Use for File Upload success/warning/error states, and CRUD operations.

micro_interactions.hover_states: All interactive elements must visibly change (darken/lighten background, transform -translate-y-[1px]).
micro_interactions.clash_animation: Subtle pulse on the red clash notification badge to draw operator attention without overwhelming.

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based. e.g., data-testid='upload-attendance-btn', data-testid='clash-metric-card', data-testid='sidebar-nav-dashboard'.

logo.description: Minimalist ampersand symbol used as EdTech Ops Hub conceptual logo

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI (.js files only) for standardized inputs, tables, tabs, and modals.
Implement the Layout strictly: dark fixed sidebar w-64, light right content area with standard spacing (p-8).
Dashboard must highlight 'Clashes Detected' dynamically in red if value > 0.
Master Calendar must be built as a dense 7-column CSS Grid. Avoid generic calendar plugins if they don't support custom colored blocks and red clash borders.
Apply IBM Plex Mono to any schedule codes, session numbers, and financial data in SOW tables.
Footer must be present on all pages exactly as: 'Engineered by Arya Ghai'.
Integrate Lucide React for sidebar and action icons.
Always apply data-testid to critical workflow elements (upload buttons, metric cards, table rows).
